nox_compatibility applies to dryer_nox, handling_nox and boiler_nox yet its operative prose still says generate using cp_air; its inputs already list both.

findings.consequence: A separate utility-stack record is directed to the incompatible line-only owner by one operative rule despite its correctly repaired row. Complete input tokens do not resolve the contradictory prose.
